C-ARCHIVE-CORPUS-BASELINE-2-D5F2E1C3.IntentSummary:
T1 plan for C-ARCHIVE-CORPUS-BASELINE-2-D5F2E1C3, authored from the approved spec (SHA-256 `31b13c5ceaca703362fc3631ffd7a376d96de439fa920990c8d7ca21f14a9ee7`) at the plan-stage checkpoint `574fd6ebcc8c1d79bc0f68ea11ec49145cb966dd`. Every normative scope, docs, archive and config guard keeps the spec's committed base `19d9e085a4523fdbe86dc5963d227d3ddc246d79`; only the lifecycle checkpoint (this plan's authoring HEAD) is newer. The owning modules are `M-REVIEW` (`src/review/core.ts` declares `LINKS: M-REVIEW`), `M-QUERY` (`src/query/core.ts` declares `LINKS: M-QUERY`), and `M-CONTEXT` (`src/grace-context.ts` declares `LINKS: M-CONTEXT`), with `V-M-REVIEW`, `V-M-QUERY`, and `V-M-CONTEXT` as their verification siblings. `.test.ts` and `.ngrace-lint.json` are not module-ownable write paths, so no synthetic `LINKS:` header or new graph anchor is added for them.
**Ordering.** T-001 rewrites the archive-corpus regression in `src/review/core.test.ts`: it adds `HISTORICAL_CLOSE_C_IDS` (the 26 `AUTHORING_ARCHIVE_C_IDS` plus `C-SUBSTANTIATION-HONESTY`), replaces the single over-broad test with a frozen historical-close zero, a retired-code-only scan over the complete current archive, and the corrected real-CLI T-005 observability test, and preserves the existing positive `identical-tree` fixtures. T-002 repairs the one implementation-source `collectCodeFiles` call in `src/query/core.ts` to exclude `ARTIFACT_DIR` and adds focused regression coverage in `src/grace-query.test.ts` (query half) and `src/grace-context.test.ts` (consumer half). T-003 appends the single `bun run validate:ci` entry to `.ngrace-lint.json` `closeEvidenceCommandShapes`. The three writes are disjoint, but the executor runs them serially with no concurrent workers, branches, or worktrees: T-001 is first because the repaired suite is the subject the post-archive whole-CI criterion protects; T-003 is last because its exact-delta guard and `--fail-on warnings` lint are meaningful only once the suite and the whole-CI criterion it unblocks are both in place, and because the config prefix is what makes `AC-CI-GREEN`'s `CloseEvidence` discriminating.
**All 13 approved `AC-*` are close-bound with complete `CloseEvidence`**, so no task carries `<Satisfies>`; a `Satisfies` of a close-bound criterion is an error and a close-bound criterion is not a forgotten mapping. The full CI-equivalent `bun run validate:ci` is the plan's `TargetAssertions` `MustPassCommand` under `--assertions final --run-commands` before apply/archive, and it is also the post-archive `AC-CI-GREEN` `CloseEvidence`; the two runs are distinct obligations and the plan claims no invocation count. Per `ngrace-plan` rule 19 the same `CloseEvidence` commands and the full CI are driven in a faithful post-close planning copy before approval. `ObservedWriteScope` names the five implementation paths, the active run ledger artifacts (`run.xml`, `run-ledger.xml`, and the `run/**` loose-event glob), and the bundle's own archive arrival glob; the bundle's own `spec.xml`, `plan.xml`, and `design-context.xml` are not listed because review skips them by identity (rule 15), and the whole active bundle directory is already excluded by `AC-WRITE-POPULATION-BOUNDED`. No record entry is paid and no record XML is flushed.
**Close execution order (guidance; the authority owns the real gates).** The close is a two-verdict sequence: pre-archive `ngrace review` supplies findings for `gate verdict`, which permits `gate apply`, `gate apply` and `gate archive` then permit, `ngrace apply` writes applied statuses and moves the bundle into the archive, and finally a post-archive `ngrace gate verdict --change C-ID --outcome pass` evaluates every `CloseEvidence` command in the applied-archive state and records a `Result`/`Exit` pair per criterion. The post-archive verdict refuses `pass` on any failed `CloseEvidence` command and its acknowledgements cannot override a command failure; the pre-archive verdict does not evaluate `CloseEvidence`. The archive gate requires an empty `run/`, so a terminal cursor event precedes `cursor fold`. The `TargetAssertions` structural checks are driven with `--assertions target` and no `--run-commands`, which reports the `MustPassCommand` as unevaluated by design; the command's actual proof is the `--assertions final --run-commands` drive and the separate post-archive `AC-CI-GREEN` `CloseEvidence`, per `ngrace-plan` rule 20. No count of full-CI invocations is asserted.
**T-005 identity note.** The spec's `AC-T005-OBSERVABLE` binds the retained finding to the archived bundle `C-DECLARATION-GUARD-RETIRE-1-C69B6AB6`, code `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree`, and anchor `attempt-pair:T-005:14->15`, and records the emitted 16-hex `findingId` rather than pinning one value. `findingId` hashes the truthful resolved anchor file (`src/review/core.ts:340-352` over the resolver at `src/review/core.ts:1389-1403`): with the empty `.ngrace/changes/archive/C-DECLARATION-GUARD-RETIRE-1-C69B6AB6/run/` directory physically present the resolver selects `.../run` and the id is `792aa42b0c989c73`; in a fresh checkout without that untracked, empty directory the anchor resolves to `.../run-ledger.xml` and the id is `9ec25fd441b9122a`. The plan-time copy proof drives both; the regression asserts the stable identity and only checks that the id is 16 hex characters.

T-001.Title: Rewrite the archive-corpus regression to freeze the 27-bundle historical close membership and keep the retired-code scan over the whole archive

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `src/review/core.test.ts` adds `const HISTORICAL_CLOSE_C_IDS = [...AUTHORING_ARCHIVE_C_IDS, "C-SUBSTANTIATION-HONESTY"] as const;` beside the existing `AUTHORING_ARCHIVE_C_IDS`, and the single test `archive corpus: zero live and retired findings on every dynamically enumerated C-*` is removed.

A test titled to be selectable by `-t "historical close corpus"` enumerates the complete archive `C-*` directories, asserts every `HISTORICAL_CLOSE_C_IDS` member is present, then runs `runReview` over exactly the 27 historical members and asserts 0 live `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` and 0 retired `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated` findings with both aggregates 0. It asserts no exact whole-archive size and requires no historical git object at runtime.

A test titled to be selectable by `-t "complete archive retired code"` enumerates the complete current archive and asserts 0 retired `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated` findings across it, with no live-zero assertion over the complete archive, so a later delivery's retained live warning does not redden this test.

A test titled to be selectable by `-t "T-005 warning remains observable"` drives the real CLI (`bun ./src/grace.ts review --path . --change C-DECLARATION-GUARD-RETIRE-1-C69B6AB6 --format json`) and asserts the emitted report contains exactly one `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` finding whose anchor `anchorOrHunkKey` is `attempt-pair:T-005:14->15`, whose `file` is under that bundle's resolved location, and whose severity is warning; it tolerates the non-zero review exit (findings remain), does not synthesize the report, and only checks the recorded `findingId` matches `/^[a-f0-9]{16}$/` rather than one directory-dependent value.

The detector, its positive identical-tree fixtures, the F286 applied-reddens and abandoned-exempt fixtures, finding-id stability, warning severity, and `REVIEW_CATALOG` registration of `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` are unchanged; no immutable real attempt event is rewritten and no new finding code is added.

Verification.Command: bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts -t "complete archive retired code"
bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts -t "T-005 warning remains observable"

T-002.Title: Exclude ARTIFACT_DIR from query implementation-source collection and add focused query and context regression coverage

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: In `src/query/core.ts`, the implementation-source `collectCodeFiles` call (`src/query/core.ts:75`) passes `[ARTIFACT_DIR, ...(config?.ignoredDirs ?? [])]`, the same exclusion the root lint call uses (`src/lint/core.ts:307`), while preserving the configured `ignoredDirs` and `codeExtensions`. The independent `validateNgraceProject` artifact checks, the active and archived XML readers, the graph and verification projections, and the malformed-artifact refusal are unchanged; the generic walker is not modified, `.ngrace/scratch` is not pruned, and `.ngrace` is not added to `ignoredDirs`.

`src/grace-query.test.ts` gains tests selectable by `-t "implementation source excludes .ngrace code"` that plant an ordinary governed-code decoy under `.ngrace`, assert a real project source file stays discoverable, assert the decoy is absent from implementation-source and module entries, and prove configured collection in both directions: a file with an extension absent from the default `CODE_EXTENSIONS` set is absent without its `codeExtensions` configuration, present with it, and absent again after that configuration is removed; and a file in a directory named by `ignoredDirs` is present without the exclusion, absent with it, and present again after the exclusion is removed. A default extension such as `.mjs` must not stand in for the extra-extension case.

`src/grace-context.test.ts` gains tests selectable by `-t "context task slice omits .ngrace code"` that drive the real CLI (`ngrace context --task T-001 --change C-QUERY-SLICE --format json --path ROOT`) on a complete ordinary throwaway project whose selected module projection includes `M-QUERY`. The fixed invocation returns status 0 with valid JSON carrying the real source file and the declared graph/verification records (`M-QUERY`, `V-M-QUERY`); its fixed stdout is byte-identical with and without a planted ordinary `.ngrace` scratch decoy, which the unpatched collector exposes in the slice. Three refusal paths are driven, each restored byte-for-byte to the prior valid stdout. (a) Corrupting `.ngrace/graph/main.xml` and (b) corrupting a non-selected archived change spec each refuse through the project validator with nonzero status and the actual `invalid-project` error whose `issues` contain `xml.parse`. (c) Corrupting the selected active change spec — read earlier by `extractSpec` before the project index loads (`src/grace-context.ts:529-533,841-851`) — refuses with nonzero status and the actual `invalid-project` error whose message matches `Unreadable spec at` and names the selected fixture's spec path, and it carries no `issues` field; the test must not demand `xml.parse` from this reader. The comparison is over the CLI JSON bytes, never the internal text formatter.

Verification.Command: bun test --timeout=0 src/grace-query.test.ts -t "implementation source excludes .ngrace code"
bun test --timeout=0 src/grace-context.test.ts -t "context task slice omits .ngrace code"

T-003.Title: Append the exact `bun run validate:ci` CloseEvidence prefix to `.ngrace-lint.json`

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `.ngrace-lint.json` is exactly the committed base config at `19d9e085a4523fdbe86dc5963d227d3ddc246d79` with one appended `closeEvidenceCommandShapes` entry, `"bun run validate:ci"`; every other key and value (including `ignoredDirs: ["examples"]` and the three existing prefixes) is byte-preserved, and the two-space/trailing-newline format is kept. No severity is lowered, no `ignoredDirs` entry is added, and no second prefix is introduced.

`bun run ./src/grace.ts lint --path . --change C-ARCHIVE-CORPUS-BASELINE-2-D5F2E1C3 --assertions none --fail-on warnings` exits 0 with 0 errors and 0 warnings, because `bun run validate:ci` is now a configured discriminating CloseEvidence shape.

Verification.Command: tmp=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; git show 19d9e085a4523fdbe86dc5963d227d3ddc246d79:.ngrace-lint.json > "$tmp/base.json" || { ec=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $ec; }; bun -e 'const fs=require("fs");const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));b.closeEvidenceCommandShapes=[...(b.closeEvidenceCommandShapes||[]),"bun run validate:ci"];fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2],JSON.stringify(b,null,2)+"\n");' "$tmp/base.json" "$tmp/expected.json" || { ec=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $ec; }; git diff --no-index --exit-code "$tmp/expected.json" .ngrace-lint.json; ec=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $ec
bun run ./src/grace.ts lint --path . --change C-ARCHIVE-CORPUS-BASELINE-2-D5F2E1C3 --assertions none --fail-on warnings
